appearance.identity: Compact11m red-white-red taper with recessed low wooden door, open gallery, small black pedestal/lantern, domed roof and paired inclined panels.
appearance.master: Original8320-triangle source preserved exactly in an isolated leaf. Shared parent recipe remains unchanged.
appearance.browser: Far levels retain the full taper, real door recess, gallery, lantern and two panel racks; regular circular subdivisions and rail pickets are reduced. Street/closeup preserve the entire master.
appearance.exclusions: Exact doorway/panel phase, entire rocky islet, birds, tide survey, individual weathering and interiors are excluded. A bounded rock footing is an approximate visualization of the base.

geographic.notes: The inspected picture supports the red/white/red tapered tower, low door, open black gallery/lantern and bounded rock under its base. Retained mapped node supplies location. Heading0 is an explicitly approximate south-facing doorway and north-facing panels, not a measured bearing. Standard viewer PMTiles are zero at this very small islet and do not resolve its rock. Browser tiers therefore include a bounded roughly10m rock footing rising1.1m above that datum and retain the11m tower height. This is an approximate visual footing, not the complete island or a surveyed tide/focal-height datum.
